tool_input.command:
chars='ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
n=${#chars}
s=""
for ((i=0;i<86;i++)); do
  idx=$((i % n))
  s+="${chars:$idx:1}"
done
echo "$s"
echo "${#s}"
